gist.summary: Removed the unused `exponentialBackoffDelay` helper and `ExponentialBackoffOptions` from `shared/util.ts`, along with the helper’s only caller, a test in Enter. Its jitter branch could return values outside `[minDelay, maxDelay]`, but nothing on main used the helper, so the deletion does not change runtime behavior.
